tagline.en: Say one sentence, play one game

story.zh: 空仓库一个。你说想要什么游戏，Qoder 现场写，写完点「预览」就能玩。
story.en: An empty repo. Tell Qoder what game you want, it writes it on the spot, and you play it in the Preview tab.

goal.zh: 得到一个能玩的 index.html，然后按你的想法改它。
goal.en: Get a playable index.html, then change it however you like.

openingPrompt.zh: 在 index.html 里写一个贪吃蛇小游戏：单文件、不用任何依赖、黑底绿色霓虹风、方向键和 WASD 都能控制、显示分数、死了按空格重开
openingPrompt.en: Write a snake game in index.html: single file, no dependencies, black background with green neon style, arrow keys and WASD both work, show the score, press space to restart after dying

hint.zh: 等 Qoder 写完，点上面的「预览」玩一局。
hint.en: Wait for Qoder to finish, then open the Preview tab and play a round.

hint.zh: 加点料。也可以自己想一个。
hint.en: Spice it up. Or come up with your own idea.

prompt.zh: 加一个彩蛋：每吃 5 个食物蛇就变一次颜色，速度加快一点，屏幕上飘过一句夸我的话
prompt.en: Add an easter egg: every 5 foods the snake changes color, speeds up a bit, and a compliment for me floats across the screen

label.zh: 里面有能跑的游戏代码
